mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past six months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 7.2% in one month triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not exceed 7.2% in the next month or 5-day forward returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of falling federal funds rates below 0.1% and strong quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2% signals an easing cycle, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.1% AND GDPC1 growth > 2% in the past quarter
failure_condition: The combined signal does not occur or 20-day returns are not positive despite the conditions.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Federal funds rates do not decline or 20-day returns are negative despite the late-cycle expansion regime.

mechanism_narrative: Strong demand indicators (HOUST rising by >15 units) combined with robust quarterly GDP growth (>2%) signal expansionary conditions, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by >15 units in 1 month AND GDPC1 growth > 2% in the past quarter
failure_condition: The combined demand and GDP growth signals do not occur or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: An elevated Supply Potential Index (INDPRO) exceeding 110.0 in one month suggests overproduction, prompting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The Supply Potential Index does not exceed 110.0 in the next month or 20-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: An employment figure (PAYEMS) surpassing 140,000 in one month indicates a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The employment figure does not reach 140,000 in the next month or 5-day returns are not positive.

mechanism_narrative: During a post-shock recovery phase, a decline in the unemployment rate predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not decline or 60-day returns are not positive despite the post-shock recovery regime.
